verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs have a dedicated Personal access tokens page under the user profile path, and the API docs tell users to enter a personal access token for HTTP Bearer authentication. That shows PATs are a first-party way to authenticate to the platform. The evidence shows little beyond page titles and the authentication usage, so the generate-and-manage part is only implied. Missing for 10: documented token creation flow, scope selection, expiration and revocation management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
